headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.stationary_some
headlines.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Nonempty S] (f : S → Option A) (c : ℕ)
  (a : A),
  (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.row f c)).mass
      (some a) =
    ↑(min c (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.fibreSize f a)) / ↑(Fintype.card S)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrection_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)]
  (c0 : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L c0)).mass
      (some X) =
    ↑(min c0 (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X)) /
      ↑(Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrection_mass_of_le
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)]
  (c0 : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  c0 ≤ Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X →
    (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L c0)).mass
        (some X) =
      ↑c0 / ↑(Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L))
